name: The Shift — Adaptive Queue Reel
tagline: One session mixing every current Queue mode — ending on The Sweep schematic.
audience: PTCB students · pharmacy educators · social media · product demos
estimatedSecNote: Actual duration is driven by ElevenLabs per-line synthesis in DemoForge

steps.narration: The Shift Queue is an adaptive study session — it reads your mastery, picks the right mode at the right moment, and runs the whole thing for you.
Seven live modes in one deploy — MCQ, Streak, Blueprints, Matrix, Minefield, Polarity, Drop — then The Sweep as the prestige closer.
Deploy — first mission is straight MCQ. Quick hit, baseline recall.
Streak Run — keep the multiplier climbing. Miss and it resets.
Blueprints — rebuild a real procedure step by step. One wrong pick drains stability.
The Matrix — structure the setup. Place every fact where it belongs before you lock the answer.
Minefield — breach the grid one cell at a time. Wrong cell, detonation.
Polarity — secure the network node by node. Resolve the volley or the link drops.
The Drop — react before the term fades. Same queue, higher pressure.
And The Sweep — the prestige schematic. Zone by zone, flag the defects. That's the Queue: every mode, one session, zero setup.
